name: Iron Fist
body:
Your fists can punch through wood, steel and even stone.

Prerequisite(s): Str 15, Toughness

Benefit: When attempting to sunder or smash an object, the objects hardness is reduced by your Strength modifier. With this feat, you cannot choose to deal subdual damage with your fists.
